The `.gitignore` file in the `python-backend` codebase specifies that the `gitlab-config`, `gitlab-data`, and `gitlab-logs` directories should be ignored by Git.

# Purpose
The file contents specify a directory structure for a GitLab instance, designating separate directories for configuration files (`/gitlab-config`), persistent data storage (`/gitlab-data`), and log files (`/gitlab-logs`). This organization facilitates the management and maintenance of GitLab by clearly separating configuration, data, and logs.
